properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.enabled
properties.description: Whether managed Flink features are globally enabled.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.credentials.master-keys
properties.description: Comma-separated version=Base64(AES key) credential master keys injected by the deployment environment. Never store key values in source control.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.credentials.active-key-version
properties.description: Active credential master key version used for new encryption. Zero keeps credential writes unavailable.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Volcengine managed Flink provider is enabled. The global managed Flink flag must also be enabled.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.endpoint
properties.description: Official Volcengine OpenAPI endpoint. Only the official HTTPS host is accepted outside local tests.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Volcengine OpenAPI TCP/TLS connection timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.request-timeout-ms
properties.description: Volcengine OpenAPI read request timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.max-read-retries
properties.description: Maximum retries for retryable read-only Volcengine OpenAPI requests.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.initial-backoff-ms
properties.description: Initial retry backoff for read-only Volcengine OpenAPI requests.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.max-backoff-ms
properties.description: Maximum retry backoff for read-only Volcengine OpenAPI requests.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.max-concurrent-requests-per-account
properties.description: Maximum concurrent Volcengine OpenAPI requests for one cloud account.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.min-request-interval-ms
properties.description: Minimum spacing between Volcengine OpenAPI requests for one cloud account.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.providers.volcengine.client.capability-ttl-minutes
properties.description: TTL of the verified built-in Volcengine Flink capability metadata.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.enabled
properties.description: Whether database-leased managed Flink job synchronization is enabled.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.scheduler-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay between managed Flink synchronization batch scans.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.scheduler-initial-delay-ms
properties.description: Initial delay before managed Flink synchronization starts.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum managed Flink applications considered by one synchronization batch.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.lease-seconds
properties.description: Database lease duration for one managed Flink status lookup.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.transition-interval-seconds
properties.description: Polling interval for managed Flink jobs in a lifecycle transition.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.running-interval-seconds
properties.description: Polling interval for running managed Flink jobs.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.observation-interval-seconds
properties.description: Polling interval for failed, unknown, or missing managed Flink jobs.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.lost-failure-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive lookup failures before a managed Flink application becomes LOST.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.max-backoff-seconds
properties.description: Maximum managed Flink lookup failure backoff.

properties.name: streampark.managed-flink.watcher.jitter-percent
properties.description: Maximum positive jitter percentage added to managed Flink polling intervals.
